$comment: Radio groups of the native toolkit (#882): the segmented choice (also the preset choice) and the swatch choice. Taken from the current Settings, which is the spec (ui/shell/styles/_settings.scss): button.settings-preset-btn and button.accent-circle-btn. Final values require owner live review.
Default applies to every dark/reduceTransparency variant; variants override whole fields like list.json. Exported once as choices in each components.json mode variant.

segmented.source: button.settings-preset-btn: padding 5px 14px, 1px border var(--nidara-border), font-size $fse-small, radius $nidara-radius-sm (components common.radius); selected = .nidara-btn--primary, the accent with accent-fg text. Rest/hover/pressed: --nidara-surface / -hover / -active with --nidara-text, weight $fw-medium; the chosen one's hover mixes 15% white into the accent and its press 30% black; disabled 0.45 opacity. minContentHeight is the button's (button.json): the segment's text line.

swatch.source: button.accent-circle-btn: min 30px, 3px border, selected = border and a 2px outer ring of --nidara-text, hover border --nidara-text-dim. Gap: space-2 between swatches (provisional).
